Terms of Service & Master Agreement

Effective Date: March 18, 2026 · Version 6.3.0 · Governing Open Core Software & Cloud SaaS Services

Core Principles & Facility Guarantees

Deterministic Safety

Non-overridable IDDSI dysphagia and allergen hard-blocks protecting resident wellness.

Your facility data belongs to you. Export complete records in JSON, CSV, or SQLite anytime.

01. Structure of Agreement & Open Core Architecture

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between Shoreline Operations LLC ("Shoreline", "we", "us") and the healthcare organization or healthcare dining operating entity ("Facility", "Subscriber", "you").

Shoreline operates under an Open Core software model:

  • Community Open Core: The single-facility dietary operating engine (including local recipe scaling, offline kitchen sheets, HACCP temp logging, and local census roster) is licensed under the Free/Open Source Software terms published in our repository.
  • Commercial Cloud SaaS & Enterprise Modules: Proprietary multi-facility capabilities—including real-time PointClickCare EHR two-way sync, automated Dennis/Sysco split MRP purchasing, 3-way invoice matching, CMS-2567 federal survey binder compilation, and managed cloud backups—are governed exclusively by these commercial terms and active subscription tiers.

02. Clinical Care Responsibilities & Medical Disclaimer

Deterministic Enforcement Notice

Shoreline Care OS provides algorithmic cross-referencing and deterministic guardrails for therapeutic diet orders, IDDSI 2.0 textures, and allergen exclusions. However, Shoreline is an operational tool and is not a licensed medical practitioner.

Facility medical directors, attending physicians, Certified Dietary Managers (CDM/CFPP), and Registered Dietitians (RD/RDN) retain sole clinical authority and responsibility for prescribing and verifying resident nutritional care plans. Shoreline deterministically enforces the clinical orders entered into the system (preventing delivery of non-compliant meals), but Facility remains responsible for verifying that EHR orders accurately reflect clinical assessments.

03. Subscriptions, Billing & Facility Licensing

Commercial SaaS subscriptions are billed monthly or annually per licensed facility bed/census tier. Payment is processed via credit card, ACH transfer, or distributor invoice credit arrangement.

  • License Entitlement: Cloud features verify entitlement via cryptographic license keys signed with Ed25519 signatures. Offline grace periods allow continuous kitchen execution for up to 72 hours without active internet connection.
  • No Surprise Seat Fees: Kitchen tablet kiosks, line cook stations, and nursing triage seats do not incur per-user license penalties. Subscriptions are priced transparently per facility.
  • Cancellation: Subscriptions may be canceled with 30 days written notice before the next billing cycle.

04. Facility Data Ownership & Portability

Facility retains 100% legal ownership of all resident records, nutritional formulations, distributor contract pricing, and operational logs entered into Shoreline.

In accordance with our Zero Vendor Lock-In guarantee, Facility administrators can generate a full database export (JSON, CSV, or SQLite snapshot) directly from the administration portal at any time, including upon termination of service. Shoreline will not withhold or delay data exports for any reason.

05. Service Level Agreement (SLA) & Offline Resilience

For Enterprise Cloud SaaS customers, Shoreline commits to a 99.9% Monthly Uptime SLA for cloud API endpoints, excluding scheduled maintenance windows announced at least 48 hours in advance.

Because healthcare dining cannot stop during internet outages, Shoreline implements local SQLite caching and IndexedDB offline mutation queues in every kitchen tablet kiosk. Line cooks can continue printing tickets, logging HACCP temperatures, and checking off meals offline; all pending records synchronize deterministically when connectivity is restored.

06. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, punitive, or consequential damages arising from this Agreement. Shoreline's aggregate liability for direct claims under any commercial order shall be capped at the total fees paid by Facility in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to liability.

07. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Maine, without giving effect to conflict of laws principles. The parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Cumberland County, Maine.
